provision_review.why: Annex II of 90 FR 59281 inserts heading 9903.02.82 only for goods entered on or after November 14, 2025. The pre-fix module starts all seven rules on 2025-08-07, when the heading did not yet exist; the post-fix module starts them on 2025-11-14. provision.txt is just the heading text with its rates and carries no date, so it cannot decide the case.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: All seven rules started at 2025-08-07, three months before Annex II inserted heading 9903.02.82, so the module applied a heading that did not yet exist to entries from 2025-08-07 through 2025-11-13 — the opposite direction of error from its siblings, and overlapping the still-operative predecessor 9903.02.58.
triage.triage_notes: Distinct from the other successor modules: this one was too early (2025-08-07), not too late (2026-02-15), which is why the commit calls it a 'premature' start; pre-fix it overlapped heading 9903.02.58's own window for that span. Source verified: same Annex II insertion of 9903.02.82-9903.02.91 effective November 14, 2025 (see index 3 notes). Companion test dates moved with it (test file, not this module file). No formula change; summary, corpus_citation_paths and two effective_period atoms per rule added.
triage.verifier_justification: The diff flips `effective_from` from '2025-08-07' to '2025-11-14' on the version of all seven rules in the ch-82 module, which is a version-window change and therefore meaning-bearing, not bookkeeping. New headings 9903.02.82-9903.02.91 shall be inserted in numerical sequence", so heading 9903.02.82 did not exist before 2025-11-14 and the pre-fix start date disagreed with the source by three months while the predecessor .58 was still operative (terminated 2025-11-13 in the sibling diff).
